saw_lines: Men weighing hormone care want to know how it ships and what it costs before they book a blood draw.
So the sale is lost in the first line when the shipping question goes unanswered and the buyer leaves.
Your 13 of 27 copy ads open on the same Amazon, Forbes and Fortune list, so test two new openers built on the one-to-one clinician consult and retest.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 17 Nov 2026
points: 13 of your 27 copy ads open on the same Amazon, Forbes and Fortune list, so they compete for the same men. Test two new openers built on the one-to-one clinician consult and the retest step.
Your homepage offers free shipping, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer has no answer to the first question. Put free shipping in line one of each ad for new buyers.
The offer appears after 51% of the copy on a median ad of 91 words, so buyers who stop early never see it. Move the offer into the first two lines of every ad, then keep the story below it.
One exact copy runs in 13 of 27 ads, so those buyers see the same story again and again. Keep the copy that works, but change the opening line and the creative in each ad so the feed stops repeating.
